title: A standing liquidity warning on every ready-made (row 15 match line)
reference_behaviour: Every preset load carries the same liquidity-risk note that odd strike multiples may not be liquid, whatever the actual strikes.
ours: SPEC CHANGE: REQ-085 AC-1 fires each warning only on a measured condition (low_liquidity per REQ-085 AC-4); a blanket note on every preset departs from it.
